svg.aria-label: One 3:2 photo meeting a square frame three ways, each made by Wrangler. Crop fills the frame and cuts the edges. Pad keeps the whole photo on its own backdrop. Inside keeps the whole photo and treats the frame as a limit.

svg.text: ■ SIZE · ONE 3:2 PHOTO, ONE SQUARE FRAME
